# Model Examples

Betacrawler is electronics, not a chassis — this page showcases printable and buildable models
that can house the electronics and be driven with them. Anything with two independently driven
tracks and room to mount a board, two ESCs and a battery is a candidate; these are starting points,
not a definitive list.

Check a model's own page for scale, motor mounts and battery space before committing to it — fit
against your specific motors, ESCs and battery is on you to verify.

## RC Tank - Staind

A printable tank chassis by **Staind**, with brushless motor brackets, gearboxes and a universal
ESC holder — a good match for Betacrawler's brushless ESCs. Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

**[thingiverse.com/thing:2414983](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2414983)**
